messages.snippet: Sarah - separate from Kingsmoor, where did we land on the Meridian Trade Park matter from last year?
messages.subject: Meridian Trade Park - any update?
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah - separate from Kingsmoor, where did we land on the Meridian Trade Park matter from last year? Marcus asked whether the rent deposit deed with the ground-floor tenant was ever formally assigned. No rush, just closing the loop on our side.

Helena
